target.title: fix: preserve session labels across stale rollover
target.body:
Closes #101451

AI-assisted

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users who add a custom label to a dashboard session in Control UI could lose that label when the same session key later rolls over to a new sessionId during stale daily/idle session lifecycle activity.

## Why This Change Was Made

The implicit rollover path already preserves user-owned model/auth and behavior overrides when an existing entry mints a new sessionId, but label metadata was still only carried by explicit /new and /reset. This change carries the existing label and displayName in that shared rollover path while leaving spawn lineage limited to explicit reset triggers.

## User Impact

Dashboard session labels remain attached to the same session key across automatic sessionId rotation, so users do not have to reapply labels after normal session lifecycle activity.

## Evidence

Before: with the production carryover lines temporarily removed, the new focused regression failed with expected undefined to be "Other" at src/auto-reply/reply/session.test.ts:1325.

After:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/auto-reply/reply/session.test.ts -t "preserves user labels across dashboard session stale rollover"
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests  1 passed | 135 skipped (136)
```

```text
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests  136 passed (136)
```

Live local model proof:

```text
pnpm openclaw agent --local --model deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro --session-key agent:main:dashboard-label-proof-101451 --message "Reply exactly: LABEL_PROOF_OK" --json --timeout 180
payload text: LABEL_PROOF_OK
provider/model: deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro
stopReason: stop
```

Stale dashboard rollover metadata proof:

```text
node --import tsx --input-type=module <<'SCRIPT'
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import os from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import { initSessionState } from "./src/auto-reply/reply/session.ts";

const root = await fs.mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "openclaw-101451-proof-"));
const storePath = path.join(root, "sessions.json");
const sessionKey = "agent:main:dashboard:8c0b2b68-05e1-4b25-a8c2-ef6f43a01f77";
const beforeSessionId = "dashboard-session-before-rollover";
const staleStartedAt = Date.now() - 48 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

await fs.writeFile(storePath, JSON.stringify({
  [sessionKey]: {
    sessionId: beforeSessionId,
    updatedAt: staleStartedAt,
    sessionStartedAt: staleStartedAt,
    lastInteractionAt: staleStartedAt,
    label: "Other",
    displayName: "Dashboard Chat",
  },
}), "utf8");

const before = JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(storePath, "utf8"))[sessionKey];
const result = await initSessionState({
  ctx: { RawBody: "continue", ChatType: "direct", SessionKey: sessionKey },
  cfg: { session: { store: storePath } },
  commandAuthorized: true,
});
const after = JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(storePath, "utf8"))[sessionKey];

console.log(JSON.stringify({
  proof: "openclaw-101451-stale-rollover-label-retention",
  sessionKey,
  storePath: path.join("[tmp]", path.basename(root), "sessions.json"),
  before: { sessionId: before.sessionId, label: before.label, displayName: before.displayName },
  rollover: {
    isNewSession: result.isNewSession,
    resetTriggered: result.resetTriggered,
    sessionIdChanged: result.sessionId !== beforeSessionId,
  },
  after: { sessionId: after.sessionId, label: after.label, displayName: after.displayName },
}, null, 2));
SCRIPT
```
